== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The early Rep gained protection whenever Neb was in battle. Later requires battle with your Rep. The alien defense +2 is unchanged. The old slip cutout preserves the physical Decipher Warrior icon, also confirmed by both period supplements; the 2006 slip physically redraws it rather than granting the characteristic.
